cover.report_type: YEAR-END REPORT: January 31 of each year

_meta.notes: CHUNK-FILE FLAG CONFIRMED AT THE PAGE: the cover's 'Office Sought' cell IS BLANK - verified at 600 dpi, left empty by the filer and NOT covered by the county's redaction bar - and the District Number cell beside it is blank as well. The office is therefore read from the TOP-ROW 'Office' cell, which reads 'COUNTY AUDITOR' in the filer's hand; that value is what is recorded in cover.office_sought, and this substitution is the reason to say so here. The 2008-era-form precedent (two office boxes, top-row value promoted when Office Sought is empty) applies. Everything else in the chunk file (candidate SCOTT TINGLEY, office Auditor, date 2018-01-31, Year-End) is CONFIRMED: the YEAR-END REPORT January 31 box is the only Type-of-Report box ticked, the signature is dated 1/31/2018, the Summary Page's own header box carries the last name TINGLEY and Date of Report 1/31/2018, and the clerk's RECEIVED IN OFFICE stamp reads JAN 31 2018. Form title is '2017 Financial Disclosure Report For a Candidate'. NEITHER amendment box (Yes / No) is ticked - is_amendment is honestly blank, not 'No'. Summary lines 1 and 2 carry a plain written numeral '0' in both columns (an ordinary zero, NOT a slashed-zero nil glyph); lines 4, 5 and 6 are left blank. THIS IS A ZERO-ACTIVITY YEAR-END FILING on an open account holding $93.84 - both schedules exist and are blank, which is a real zero, never 'no donors' inferred from an absent row set. The filing also carries the three trailing 'Other Campaign Accounts' pages (p5 Summary Page Other Campaign Accounts, whose Column B is 'Year to Date' and is a DIFFERENT table from the standard Summary Page; p6 Itemized Contributions from Other Campaign Accounts; p7 Itemized Expenditures from Other Campaign Accounts) - all three are entirely blank, including every total cell, and nothing from them is merged into the standard sides or emitted as rows. PAGE 8 IS A GHOST PAGE: measured at 200 dpi it is blank apart from a scanner shadow strip at the right edge (mean grey 254.9, 2,899 dark pixels in 3.74 M) - no form, no text, nothing to transcribe. Schedule A prints an Occupation/Employer column but it is empty along with the rest of the grid, so no occupation cells were captured for this filing. The county's redaction bar covers the cover's street-address block and the phone/fax/email block; there is no contributor address block to redact because Schedule A is empty.

contributions.detail: p3 is the county Schedule A grid, present and WHOLLY BLANK - all 15 ruled data rows empty, and the SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE and TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED cells are themselves left blank (blank, NOT a zero glyph - schedule_total is therefore honestly empty, not 0). Zero rows here is a REAL ZERO the transcriber looked at, and it agrees with Summary line 1 Column A, which the filer wrote as a plain '0' in both Column A and Column B.

expenditures.detail: p4 is the county Schedule B grid, present and WHOLLY BLANK - all 14 ruled data rows empty, SUBTOTAL and TOTAL EXPENDITUTRES MADE cells left blank. Real zero, agreeing with Summary line 2 Column A ('0', and Column B '0').

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: Neither schedule page prints a filled subtotal - both the SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE and the schedule TOTAL cells are blank on p3 and on p4, so the page-subtotal gate is NOT AVAILABLE on either side. Gated instead on the Summary Page: lines 1 and 2 Column A are each a plain written '0', and both schedules are empty, so rows-sum 0.00 = stated 0 on both sides.
itemized.escalation_note: p1 Office Sought + District Number value row at 600 dpi, twice (first crop landed on the printed labels; the second, on the value row beneath them, settled that BOTH cells are genuinely empty and that the black bar to their right is the phone/fax/email redaction, which does not reach either cell).
